purpose: Standalone offline Android model inspection range; never overwrite Project-hail/New-game- or use as automatic game promotion.

model_input.delivery: user-selected local document; no cloud runtime requirement
supported: glTF 2.0 .glb embedded triangle geometry (rest pose only)

review_positions.review_target: silhouette and visible details near camera
distant shape recognition and visual clutter

asset_lifecycle.tested_models: local transient imports; only source/recipes and compact results persist
asset_lifecycle.user_requested_apk: replaceable private prerelease; avoid blocked GitHub Actions artifact quota
asset_lifecycle.cleanup_scope: only confirmed unused files within new Model Range module; retain all older game assets and source

downstream_roles.Project-hail: Optional visual QA/legacy-game compatibility and knight preservation; no automatic engine replacement
downstream_roles.New-game-: Potential game-model consumer; manually export candidate to local GLB or OBJ before tester import
downstream_roles.Trion-Assistant-Lab: Optional future local document handoff; do not wire network or remove chat/game builder UI

evidence.apk_delivery: Actions artifact attempt blocked by quota; review prerelease job is separate

guardrails: Do not merge the M13 range directly into existing Project-hail or ECHOFORM applications
Do not assert green source tests equal graphics acceptance
No cross-repository model binaries or destructive history changes
Maintain role-specific manual or review-gated emulator policy
